test: CPOE x pressure — player-level conditional table (NGS CPOE x PFR pressure counts)
finding: CPOE under heavy pressure (9+) stays POSITIVE (+1.47) — the pressure premium concentrates in mobile/elite QBs who keep producing under duress. The 6-9 dip (n=39) is the mid-tier dead zone. Bad-throw rate is FLAT in pressure (0.149-0.172) — pressure changes WHO throws badly, not HOW bad the average throw is. Third independent confirmation that pressure effects are absorbed inside the completion/throwaway decision, not the throw quality.
implication_for_props: QB passing prop models should condition on WHO (QB mobility class) not HOW MUCH (pressure counts). The market prices pressure counts; the residual lives in the QB class interaction.
label: DIAGNOSTIC
